skills.name: Thunder's Wrath
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Eudora calls down a blast of lightning on the target area, dealing to targets at the center. Then it strikes targets outside the center, dealing. Every time Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by Superconductor, it triggers a Thunderburst centered on the Superconductor target after a short delay, dealing.

skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: During fight, Fanny deals 10%–20% extra damage to enemies hit (scales with flying speed[speed unknown]) and applies a stack of Prey Mark|mark to them (up to 2 stacks) on each attack. Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack for her. The energy restoration is reduced[amount unknown] if she hits multiple enemy heroes within a short period of time.[duration unknown]

skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction that pulls her to the first obstacle hit. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy runs out. Each successive cast reduces the skill's energy cost by 2. Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike upon hitting an enemy mid-flight, as long as her energy is sufficient.

skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing. Each stack of Prey Mark of the target increases this damage by 30%.

skills.name: Vicious Retrieval
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Every 4 seconds, Faramis's next skill against enemy heroes and summoned objects generates a soul fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore and gain 2 extra Magic Power (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed soul fragments to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance[how much?] to drop soul fragments.

skills.name: Shadow Stampede
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% extra Movement Speed, 25 extra Physical and Magic Defense, 20% cooldown reduction of this skill, and the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes that come into contact with Faramis in this state are dealt and applied with a Nether Mark|mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing. Use again to leave the Shadow state early and drags marked enemies toward him. The range of soul fragment absorption is increased while this skill is active.

skills.name: Ghost Bursters
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing (splits up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).

skills.name: Nether Realm
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the Nether Realm|e for 6s, making affected allied hero (including himself) enter the Specter|e state and granting them plus% extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When Specter|e state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1s. An allied hero's Specter|e state ends when they leave the Nether Realm|e.

skills.name: Dew
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Dew's Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. After leaving combat for 5 seconds, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30 seconds cooldown), which will grant them a each time they are healed by Floryn. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.

skills.name: Sow
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at a target enemy, dealing. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their by.

skills.name: Sprout
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and revealing their positions briefly).[duration needed]

skills.name: Bloom
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, recovering to all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regen effects by 12% for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Wasteland Force
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force|e (up to 10 stacks). Franco will consume all Wasteland Force stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.

skills.name: Iron Hook
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing dragging them to Franco.

skills.name: Fury Shock
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Franco lashes out, dealing Physical Damage equal to 300–450 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Bloody Hunt
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing.

skills.name: Crystalline Armor
skills.description: Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5 seconds each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimate costs different numbers of Combo Points at different skill levels. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy|E, which decays after 5 seconds at a rate of 10% Max HP per second. Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy|E into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.description: Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals.[skill duration needed] This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3 seconds.[skill duration needed]

skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.description: Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 Combo Point.

skills.name: Appraiser's Wrath
skills.description: Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his Crystal Energy as Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored Crystal Energy to HP. This skill costs 3 Combo Points.

skills.name: Power of Einherjar
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Freya gains 1 Sacred Orb with each Basic Attack (up to 6 Sacred Orbs). Consuming 1 Sacred Orb grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack (max 6 stacks). Sacred Orbs gradually recover when out of combat.

skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining and dealing to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4 seconds.

skills.name: Valkyrie Slash
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Sacred Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

skills.name: Valkyrie Descent
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Freya selects a target area and dives down as a Valkyrie (gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reducion), dealing and 40% slow to enemies in her path and at the landing point for 2 seconds. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 12 seconds, during which her Basic Attacks deal 30-60 extra damage (extra damage cannot Crit) and she recovers per Basic Attack, and her Basic Attacks deal splash damage.

skills.name: Steel Bones
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 100). He gains 5 Rage (up to 100)For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before reduction). Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal (8.2-11* Consumed Rage) Magic Damage and recover (8 * Consumed Rage) HP.

skills.name: Blast Iron Fist
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take per second and be slowed by 30%.

skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies on the path to attack him and deal for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance scales with the channel time. Canceling the Skill reduces 50% of the remaining Cooldown.

skills.name: Avatar of the Guardian
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1 second. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

skills.name: Stick, Stick
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they're hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.

skills.name: Slam, Slam
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing to the enemy. At the final, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3 seconds to deal to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, reset the skill's cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5%-5% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if hits an enemy hero).

skills.name: Spread, Spread
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Gloo splits into Goos, dealing to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5 seconds. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals every 0.25 seconds to enemies it touches, lasting 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a distance.

skills.name: Grab, Grab
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Unlocked when any enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25%-30% of its Max HP. For the duration, its Basic Attacks are converted to deal, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. If the target dies while attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5 seconds.

skills.name: Mystic Favor
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with Basic Attacks or skills within a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

skills.name: Mystic Projectile
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1 second.

skills.name: Mystic Injunction
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Gord create an energy field in the target area, dealing every 0.3 second to enemies within (up to 13 times).

skills.name: Mystic Gush
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing to enemies hit every 0.2 seconds (up to 16 times). The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

skills.name: Capriccio
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a staring Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy. Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy Cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.

skills.name: Rhapsody
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. Each bullet deals an additional 70 damage to Creeps and Minions. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 15%. Granger stops firing when he runs out Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.

skills.name: Rondo
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15%-25% Energy for his Gun. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 second.

skills.name: Death Sonata
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be slowed and revealed for a brief duration. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot. Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

skills.name: Bastion of Stone
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Grock gains a Shield equal to 10% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal equal to% of the target's Max HP (capped at against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12 seconds cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain. Grock's skills cannot be interrupted and gains% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active.

skills.name: Mighty Swing
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra equal to% of their Max HP (capped at against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

skills.name: Earthen Rampart
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing and knocking enemies towards him. Use Again: Cancel the wall early.

skills.name: Tectonic Charge
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Grock charges forward, dealing to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1 second and deals. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

skills.name: Super Magic
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals with her Basic Attacks. Guinevere builds up Super Magic each time she deals damage and when she's fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing on hit and restoring. Enemies hit by Guinevere's enhanced Basic Attack, Energy Wave, or Spatial Migration are marked for 5 seconds. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.

skills.name: Energy Wave
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.2 seconds. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1 second.

skills.name: Spatial Migration
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing [,stunning enemies within it for 1 second]. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1 second and take additional Magic Damage. After cast, Guinevere can reactivate the skill in 5 seconds to blink toward the target direction [while invisible for 0.5 seconds] and leave an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and will explode in 1.5 seconds, dealing to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Violet Requiem
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Guinevere creates a force field around her [for 2 seconds], attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2 seconds, dealing in total. If the enemy hit is already airborne, they will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times. Guinevere is immune to Crowd Control while casting this skill.

skills.name: Dagger Specialist
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's max HP and restore to himself.

skills.name: Sword Spike
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing to the first enemy hit and marking them. Use Again|e}: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

skills.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Gusion throws a volley of [five] daggers in the target direction, each dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2 seconds (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%). Use Again:|e Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing to enemies in its path.

skills.name: Incandescence
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaugther was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward. Use Again:|e Gusion dashes a short distance in the target location.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and Skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies (the first bounce deals 40% of the damage, and subsequent bounces deal 85% of the previous). Bounces from her Basic Attacks inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Passive:|e The secret Ninjutsu of the Scarlet Shadow makes Hanabi immune to control effects when she has a shield from any source. Active:|e Hanabi gains a for 5 seconds. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% Movement Speed, 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of damage dealt will also be added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units). The shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1 second. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal on them with no damage decay.

skills.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds. After 1 second, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decays 20% damage.

skills.name: Ame No Habakiri
skills.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Demon Feast
skills.description: This skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP. When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals, recovers 10%~20% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Dark Mist
skills.description: Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit). The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.

skills.name: Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja
skills.description: Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 Energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it's a hero. He gains 15 Energy when attacking a hero, and 45 Energy when attacking the Turtle or the Lord. When Energy runs out, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's position. While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed and 30% Attack Speed. Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% and becoming untargetable during the return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Ame no Habakiri
skills.description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.

skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Soul Snatch
skills.description: Hanekage dashes to an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases this damage by 20%. At max Dark Ninjutsu stacks, he deals 12 (+3% Extra Physical Attack)% target's extra damage (ignores 30% of target's ) and recovers 150 (+80% Total Physical Attack) HP. This skill can be cast on the Turtle or Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).

skills.name: Forbidden Ninjutsu: Black Mist
skills.description: Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path airborne for 0.4s and dealing 405 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage (recovers 200 Energy if hitting an enemy hero), leaving a Dark Mist in the area he passes through. The mist deals 135 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%. This damage is considered Basic Attack Damage, but cannot Crit.

skills.name: Ninjutsu Flee: Return
skills.description: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and exits the Hanekage form.

skills.name: Key Insight
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

skills.name: Synchro Fission
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom will then release Synchro Fission toward each other, dealing to all enemy units on the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, dealing to all enmies in the explosion area.

skills.name: Chrono Dash
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Harith dashes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals Magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that absorbs at least damage and enhances his next Basic Attack. Harith's enhanced Basic Attack deals and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's enhanced Basic Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.

skills.name: Zaman Force
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Harith uses his Key to summon the Zaman Force. When the multidimensional rift appears, the cooldown of Chrono Dash is reduced by 4 seconds. The rift initially slows enemy heroes in the area by 70% and will continuously slows enemy heroes by 35% afterwards. If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy within and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 seconds and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds. Harith gains 15% Resilience while on the rift.

skills.name: Magic Master
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attack to deal 60 (+50%Total Physical Attack)(+60%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. His attacks reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 for 3 seconds on hit (up to 10 stacks).

skills.name: Poker Trick
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and granting him 10% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds on hit (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.

skills.name: Space Escape
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his place, increasing his Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Use Again: Use again within 4 seconds to return where the hat is and lose the speed boost.

skills.name: Deadly Magic
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at the target enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing them 200-400 (+60%Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with his skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30%Total Magic Power) plus 50% of the enemy's damage taken within the duration as Magic Damage.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of Shadow Mark|mark on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take only 30% of the damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-Minion enemy hit. Passive:|e Hayabusa permanently gains 3%–18% Spell Vamp.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash. Use Again:|e Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals to the enemy.

skills.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing. The attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark|mark and each will consume a mark to deal extra Physical Damage. Does not apply Shadow Mark.

skills.name: Shadow of Styx
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Helcurt remains in the Prowler|e state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating HP if he has not dealt any damage. He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4 seconds upon being spotted and leaves Prowler|e state 0.75 second later. Any hero killed after hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog|e that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10 seconds. Helcurt Conceals himself while within the dark fog|e.

skills.name: Hidden Terror
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Passive|e: When Helcurt is in Prowler|e state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast Active|e: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.label: Skill 2
skills.description: Passive|e: Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in Prowler|e state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored. Active|e: Helcurt fires all Deadly Stinger forward, each dealing to enemies (Minions and Creeps only take 70% of the damage) Deadly Stinger counts as a Basic Attack, but it cannot Crit.

skills.name: Dark Night Falls
skills.label: Ultimate
skills.description: Helcurt summons the Dark Night|e, reducing all enemies' sight range and making them lose sight of their allies for 3s. During Dark Night|E, Helcurt gains 40% Movement Speed. The Dark Night|e makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

skills.name: Blessing of Wilderness
skills.label: Passive
skills.description: Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances her next Basic Attack, which deals to the target, reduces the target's Movement Speed by 40%, and deals to enemies behind the target. After using the enhanced Basic Attack, this effect enters a 6 second cooldown. Hilda's Basic Attack and skills apply a Wilderness Mark on hit, which lasts up to 4 seconds and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 3%.

skills.name: Combat Ritual
skills.label: Skill 1
skills.description: Hilda gains 60% Movement Speed for 3 seconds and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% Max HP, lasting 3 seconds.

skills.name: Art of Hunting
skills.label: Skill 2
